what: On hover 8 bars (two of them double width, positions shuffled each time) fill from the bottom of the box, each separately over .2 to .45s, with the ends sticking together gooey, and on release the same bars exit upward
ease: power4.out·power2.out half and half (enter) · power4.inOut·power2.inOut half and half (exit)

options.dur: Length range of one bar (seconds) ‹min max›, default ‹0.2 0.45›
options.lag: Max delay per bar on entry (seconds), default .2
options.look: flat gives angular bars with no gooey filter
options.touch: With scroll, on touch devices it stays open while the cell’s top edge is inside the upper zone of the screen (original ENTRY phone version), by default not applied on touch
options.zone: touch: open range of scroll (share of screen height), default .7

use: Your card content here
note: Not applied by default on touch devices (hover false). The original support card is desktop only too. To open on scroll on phones like the ENTRY list, use touch: scroll. The bar panel is inserted as the first child svg of the element and sits behind the content (z-index -1)

from.where: detail.js .d-entry__item (apply card hover bars — original R3: widths [1,1,1,1,2,2,1,1]×10% shuffled · 103%→0 · .2~.45s · delay 0~.2 · −103% on leave)
recruit.js .e-item (ENTRY job card — original UP: same bar values, on phone opens when the card top edge is within 0~70% of the screen and closes when outside = touch: scroll)
